title: Patisserie Brand Continuity
description: Four reference-linked dessert brand heroes establishing a consistent pastry-boutique language.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the palette, surface finish, display rhythm, and boutique camera treatment. Images 02-04 preserve that same dessert-brand system while rotating the hero pastry, package accent, and merchandising cue.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-salon-display-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
